scope: Actual shipped session and adapter functions in local VM with synthetic DOM, FS, timers and native packets. No network, native game or Android execution.
checks: opaque join requires matching complete native room snapshot and rendered identity
room snapshots reject regressing revisions and wrong phases and recover after loading
room commands delegate only within current room and never enter world command queue
room leave rejoin and pagehide clear room identity under cover before transport teardown
room bridge publishes native state before room and redelivers unchanged packets for cover recovery
ready requests use one atomic mailbox and wait matching native acknowledgement
team spectator and literal UTF8 chat preserve native payload types without client state mutation
unknown or malformed room actions cannot write native mailbox
old matching ACK cannot survive a phase or generation change consumed by the same poll
pending room intent cancels on pagehide and bounded timeout rather than retrying into a new session
atomic mailbox failure is reported and does not permanently block future room commands
